Wrangler Air, own printed box 60×100×36 with snap lid, schematic A (no ADC)

Printed box, walls 2 mm, flat 2 mm lid on four snap hooks. DinMeter in the upper end wall, two M12 cable glands in the lower end wall. Relay along on the left, Grove 5 cm from PORT.B; left gland: 2 m Grove to the sensor and the violet ARB wire, right gland: power. Hover or tap a part for its name. For scale: Galaxy Z Fold7 folded and a cigarette pack (photo: Wikimedia Commons, AKS.9955, CC BY-SA 4.0).
